verdict: Leads surged this week, but key launch milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 7 leads from Meta at a blended cost of $74.37 per lead — and the most recent 7 days showed a 500% jump in leads as the instant-form ad format began converting far more efficiently, pulling cost per lead down 71%. That momentum is real, but it's running on a partial setup: five planned launch milestones — including LSA verification, search ads, landing pages, and Meta retargeting — have been overdue since late July, which means lead volume is lower than it should be at this stage. We are actively closing out those outstanding items so the full channel mix can run as planned. Next period, you should see Google Search and LSA traffic added to what Meta is already producing.
